en.title: Why is learned knowledge so easy to read with a linear probe?
en.origin: A limitation raised in the talk
en.question: Prediction can reward useful information. Why should that information also become accessible through such a simple readout?
en.importance: This separates possessing information from making it easy to use, and connects representation learning with interpretability.
en.context: Our note distinguishes information stored in a representation from information a simple classifier can extract. The talk’s linear-representation question is also recorded in the two secondary accounts linked below.
en.update: Park, Choe and Veitch formalize linear representations and connect them to probing and steering. A 2026 study by Kutluozen and colleagues shows that high probe accuracy alone need not establish a genuinely linear world model. These results refine the question rather than supply a universal account of how linear features form.
en.remaining: Under which data, architecture and optimization conditions do useful features become linearly accessible, and when does probe success reflect the dominant geometry?

zh.title: 为什么学到的知识，能被简单的线性探针读出来？
zh.question: 预测任务可以促使模型保存有用信息，但为什么这些信息还会变得如此容易被读取？
zh.importance: 它区分了“有知识”与“知识容易使用”，连接表示学习与可解释性。
zh.context: 本站笔记区分了表示包含信息与简单分类器能够提取信息。演讲中的线性表示问题，也见下方两份二手整理。
zh.status: 已有局部解释 · 持续研究
zh.update: Park、Choe 与 Veitch 形式化了线性表示，并建立其与探针和模型操控的联系。Kutluozen 等人在 2026 年的研究指出，高探针准确率本身不等于真正的线性世界模型。这些工作细化了问题，尚不能视为线性特征形成机制的普遍解释。
zh.remaining: 哪些数据、架构与优化条件会形成可线性读取的特征？探针成功在什么条件下反映表示的主要几何结构？
zh.location: 第八节 · 信息与可读取性的距离

en.title: How does the prediction task shape the representation?
en.origin: A conjecture discussed in the talk
en.question: When does predicting from the past demand more global structure than filling gaps using surrounding context?
en.importance: The answer could help explain which training objectives produce features useful beyond the original task.
en.context: Our note contrasts next-token prediction with filling gaps using both sides. The public accounts describe Ilya’s conjecture about difficult prediction cases; the question here concerns its scope, not a universal ranking of autoregressive and masked models.
en.update: He and colleagues’ MAE paper already demonstrated useful visual learning by masking a high proportion of image patches. It predates the talk and is relevant background, not a subsequent refutation. It shows why masking ratio and task design matter; it does not settle every comparison with autoregressive learning.
en.remaining: Holding data, model capacity and compute comparable, which prediction constraints encourage global features, and how should their transfer value be measured?
en.location: Section 8 · prediction objectives and practical needs

zh.title: 为什么不同的预测任务，会学出不同的表示？
zh.question: 只看前文预测，什么时候比利用前后文填空更需要理解整体结构？
zh.importance: 这个问题有助于解释：什么样的训练目标，能让学到的特征更好地迁移到其他任务。
zh.context: 本站笔记对比了自回归预测与双向填空。公开整理记录了伊利亚对困难预测情形的猜想；这里追踪的是适用条件，不是宣布自回归模型永远优于掩码模型。
zh.status: 依赖具体条件 · 不预设普遍优劣
zh.update: He 等人的 MAE 工作已展示：遮蔽大量图像块也能形成有用的视觉学习任务。它早于这场讲座，是相关背景而非后来的反驳。这说明遮蔽比例与任务设计需要纳入比较，但并未解决所有与自回归学习的对照问题。
zh.remaining: 在数据、容量和计算预算可比时，哪些预测约束更能促成全局特征？如何衡量这些特征的迁移价值？
zh.location: 第八节 · 预测目标与实际需求的距离

en.title: How far can practical training get toward ideal compression?
en.origin: Our question, reformulated from a stated limitation
en.question: What survives of the shortest-program perspective when models and optimization have finite resources?
en.importance: An ideal benchmark becomes more useful if it can predict the behavior of actual learning systems.
en.context: Our note identifies the gap between shortest programs and neural-network training. This question is our formulation of that gap, not a verbatim question from Ilya. The talk’s Q&A limitation is recorded in Hao Bai’s account.
en.status: Partial theoretical progress · optimization remains a gap
en.update: Shaw and colleagues (ICLR 2026) establish asymptotically optimal description-length objectives for Transformers. Their abstract also reports that standard optimizers fail to find the low-complexity solutions from random initialization in their algorithmic experiment. An asymptotic objective guarantee is therefore different from a guarantee for practical training.
en.remaining: Can we characterize the compression and transfer achievable with finite compute, and explain the roles of initialization and data order?
en.location: Section 8 · ideal programs versus actual networks

zh.title: 有限算力下的实际训练，离理想压缩还有多远？
zh.origin: 从演讲局限延伸的本站问题
zh.question: 模型容量和优化预算有限时，“最短程序”视角中哪些结论还能帮助解释实际学习？
zh.importance: 如果能预测真实训练系统的行为，理想标尺才更容易转化为可操作的研究方法。
zh.context: 本站笔记指出最短程序与神经网络训练之间的距离。这里的问法是本站重述，不是伊利亚原话；Hao Bai 的整理记录了演讲问答中对这一类比局限的讨论。
zh.status: 已有理论进展 · 优化仍有距离
zh.update: Shaw 等人（ICLR 2026）建立了 Transformer 渐近最优描述长度目标。他们也在摘要中报告：其算法任务实验里，标准优化器从随机初始化出发未能找到相应的低复杂度解。因此，目标的渐近保证与实际训练过程的保证仍是两回事。
zh.remaining: 能否刻画有限算力下可实现的压缩与迁移效果，并解释初始化和数据顺序的作用？
zh.location: 第八节 · 理想程序与实际网络的距离
